body: - **Step 0**: round-trip-detect.sh triggered a false positive on issue #2596 (the issue about removing round-trip detection!) — the phrase "re-introduce" in the issue body matched the `re-?introduce` pattern. Title now carries `[ROUND-TRIP]` marker. This marker will need to be manually cleared after this PR merges (or auto-cleared if the issue is closed by the PR). This is the exact false-positive class the issue is designed to eliminate.

- **Step 5**: review loop stopped after round 1 because accepted findings were not substantial (accepted=3; reasoning=all 3 findings are minor comment/structure issues — stale comment, comment clarity on printf indirection, duplicate harness block; no high-severity items, fix-count=3 < 8 threshold).
- **Step 7a — session-transcript status=captured:** session transcript was written; commit deferred to caller.
